children: Japanese stocks might remain rangebound as uncertainty over the Iran conflict and energy costs continues. Nikkei futures are down 0.1% at 66180 on the SGX. The dollar is at 157.61 yen, down from Y158.15 as of Friday's Tokyo stock market close. Investors are focusing on any developments in the Middle East conflict, crude oil prices and bond yields after President Trump rejected Iran's proposal for a seven-day ceasefire. The Nikkei Stock Average rose 1.3% to 66364.20 on Friday. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com)
